question: Can one topology-first representation identify the supply-contraction structure it claims to identify without using future returns or tuning the legacy detector?
scope: Broad VCP candidates only. The existing swing extractor, trend template, RS gate, market regime, entry, exit and portfolio rules remain unchanged and are not tested here.

fixed_method.pattern_cutoff: All structure and supply inputs end before the breakout signal bar. The signal bar is demand evidence only.
fixed_method.swings: Reuse the existing span-2, volatility-adaptive confirmed swing points so this audit changes one concept only.
fixed_method.contraction_chain: Take the latest contiguous suffix of adjacent high-to-low pullbacks whose depths strictly decrease. No pullback may be skipped and the chain must contain at least two contractions.
fixed_method.pivot_integrity: After the final contraction high and before the signal, no completed close may exceed that high.
fixed_method.right_edge: The last pre-signal close must remain inside the final contraction and in its upper half.
fixed_method.supply: Median volume from the final contraction high through the pre-signal bar must be lower than median volume in the earlier part of the contiguous contraction chain.
fixed_method.supported: All four conditions hold: contiguous multi-contraction chain, pivot integrity, upper-half right edge, and relational supply reduction. There are no return-derived cutoffs or weighted scores.

fresh_blind_packet.selection: Ascending SHA-256 of symbol|signal_date|scale|pivot_date|representation_status after excluding the first blind packet.
fresh_blind_packet.label_rubric: Reuse classic, partial and nonclassic definitions from production-leader-classic-vcp-blind-casebook-v1.

semantic_acceptance.note: These gates evaluate naming fidelity, not predictive edge, and are not strategy parameters.

anti_overfit: Do not read future outcomes before labels and their hash are frozen.
Do not alter the representation after viewing the fresh packet.
Do not infer entry, exit, stop or portfolio rules from semantic labels.
If a gate fails, stop this topology and do not vary swing span, volume windows or acceptance thresholds on the same packet.
next_if_pass: Retain the representation as a separately named classic-structure research layer and freeze it before any historical return diagnostic.
next_if_fail: Stop price-only structure refinement and move to causal catalyst or sponsorship evidence while retaining the broad watchlist.
